summary: Centralize NDA security enablement package (latest PDFs) with controlled sharing + distribution tracking
description:
Requester: Sales leadership + Solutions Engineering

Problem:
AEs/SEs keep asking for “the latest approved security package” to send to prospects under NDA (Security FAQ v2 PDF + compliance/security one-pagers pack). Today the links are scattered across Drive, old email forwards, and pinned Slack messages. This creates:
- Risk of sending outdated language during security review
- Access issues (wrong sharing settings; inability to verify who received restricted materials)
- Extra churn for GRC/Security responding to repeat requests

Requested outcome:
Provide a single canonical entry point for the “NDA Security Enablement Package” that:
1) Always points to the latest PDFs
2) Uses restricted sharing / permissioning consistent with evidence-sharing SOP
3) Tracks distribution (who requested, which prospect, when, and which artifacts were shared)

In scope artifacts (field-ready PDFs):
- Security FAQ v2 (final PDF)
- Compliance/Security One-Pagers Pack v2 (final PDF pack)

Out of scope:
- SOC 2 report itself (handled via GRC evidence-sharing flow)
- Contract template changes / security appendix rewrites

Proposed solution:
- Create a restricted folder in the GTM shared drive containing the latest PDFs only
- Create a short Confluence “index” page that links to the restricted folder + explains the sharing workflow (including NDA requirement and where to log distribution)
- Set up a lightweight tracking sheet (or form) to record distribution events; link it from the index page

Acceptance criteria:
- A single link that Sales/SE can bookmark and share internally
- Folder permissions are locked down (no ‘Anyone with link’)
- Clear instructions on what can be shared under NDA vs requires GRC approval
- Tracking exists and is used (minimum: requester, recipient company, artifacts sent, date, NDA status)

Notes:
Reference Slack thread about “single link to latest security kit” and ongoing enablement kit refresh (FAQ v2 + one-pagers + RFP library).
customer_impact: Internal enablement / risk reduction (prevents outdated or unapproved security materials from being sent during procurement/security review).
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Search Drive for “security faq pdf” or “enablement kit”
2. Multiple copies appear (drafts, old versions, exports)
3. AEs/SEs send whichever they find first
4. Security/GRC later receives follow-up questions due to mismatched wording/version
investigation_notes:
Findings (2026-01-15):
- Current materials are being shared from at least 3 different Drive locations, plus email attachments.
- Several deals are blocked on retention/residency wording; older PDFs are still in circulation.
- Evidence-sharing SOP exists in Confluence but is not linked from wherever AEs find the PDFs.

Constraints:
- The “package” itself is customer-shareable ONLY under NDA (per GRC guidance); therefore the internal link must be restricted and distribution should be tracked.
- We should avoid mixing the PDFs with internal-only evidence pointers (SOC 2, pen test summaries, etc.). Keep the package folder limited to customer-facing PDFs.
resolution:
Completed standardization and centralization:
- Created restricted Drive folder: “GTM > Security Enablement > NDA Package (Latest)” containing only:
  (1) Security FAQ v2 (Final PDF)
  (2) Compliance/Security One-Pagers Pack v2 (Final PDF)
- Set permissions to restricted (Redwood only). Granted view access to Sales + Solutions Engineering groups; edit access limited to Security & Compliance PM + Docs publishing lead.
- Published Confluence index page under Sales Enablement linking to the folder and explicitly stating:
  - PDFs may be shared with prospects only under NDA
  - SOC 2 report access must go through GRC (do not attach to emails without approval)
  - How to request exceptions/escalations
- Implemented distribution tracking via a shared sheet (linked from the index page) capturing: requestor, prospect, artifacts shared, date/time, NDA status, and notes.
- Added internal note for RevOps to link the index page in HubSpot snippets/templates used for security review stages.

Follow-ups:
- Quarterly review reminder owned by Naomi Feldman to ensure the index always points to the latest PDFs.
- Security/GRC to monitor tracking sheet for repeat requests from the same account (signal for a proactive security review call).
